title: Prove adaptive gate criterion and critical-root leaf bounds (no κ)
body:
#4483 certifies an adaptive compiler for particular profiles and asks which broader class admits its tail gates. This package proves a sufficient criterion from a moment crossing plus strict pointwise mirror slack, and funds a leaf-count bound at the **exact crossing exponent**:

`L(n) <= A n^theta (c + log n)^p` for every integer `n >= 1`.

The mirror condition itself implies the tilted-mean gap. At a fixed exponent with `T(t) >= P(t)`, the proof also characterizes the two-tail/ordering gates by the single condition `T(t-lambda) exp(lambda mu_P(t)) < P(t)` for some positive `lambda`. An exact counterexample passes fixed-exponent moment, mean and mirror checks while failing that condition.

The separately implemented exact checker isolates the retained **p7** and **p16** crossings and certifies complete critical-root majorants with `p=1/10, c=38, n0=121*256^100` and `p=2/5, c=133, n0=145*1024^650`. Geometry and guards are read from authenticated #4483 benchmarks; the wider exponent covers and p7's conservative mirror factor are explicit. No native word, paid invoice, κ or selected result changes.

The diff contains only `research/adaptive-gate-existence/`. Canonical base: `f9f85c1e4fa1e955ff39f10fca447e3e2a4e4adc`. Coordination: [Discussion #4525](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4525).

Validation: registered Python 3.12 replay; isolated optimized execution; 21 semantic rejection controls, exact arithmetic and symbolic mirror-integral controls; committed-byte/source-history preflight; checked 15-file export; replay without Git and with network access denied; exported source-corruption and underfunding controls. Separate author-side AI agents reviewed the proof and interval arithmetic. No formal or independent human verification is claimed.

Hosted CI has a known **upstream planning blocker**: four unchanged current-status/navigation tests fail before package replay, as [reported for #4448](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4443#discussioncomment-19109289) and reproduced on [#4521](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4521#issuecomment-6332331505). The local registered pass is not a hosted replay pass.

Remaining obligations: native all-column semantics, owned restoration, actual chronological widths and adapters, movement, precision, stock, fixed-tape execution, analytic transfer and exact recovery. The theorem concerns conditional normalized leaf counts; it does not materialize the winning words or establish practical thresholds.

Credit zxv's #4436/#4483 flow and logarithmic majorant, Jacob Alan Sussman's integer compiler, Ryanson Jonathan's corrected #4459 mirror method and invoice work, the #4433 and @1337isnot1337 p7 lineage, Cinna Davis's #4470 p16 word, Dugongue's #4479 compact consumer, and the retained native/outer sources. #4507/#4519 batching and #4521 expanded accounting remain distinct work. Prepared by Dillon with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
